name: Tax Consultant
responsibilities: Interview clients about income and deductible expenses, then prepare returns from simple individual filings up to complex small-business cases
Apply every legitimate adjustment, deduction, and credit available so a client's tax bill is minimized without stepping over the line
Explain tax law in plain terms and advise clients on future tax planning, not just this year's filing
skills: Reading financial records (income statements, expense documentation) to figure out which forms actually apply
Working tax preparation and compliance software rather than filling forms by hand
Checking your own and others' entries for arithmetic or data-entry errors before anything gets filed
Consulting tax law handbooks or bulletins to handle an atypical return instead of guessing
rawSkillPool: Reviewing income statements and expense documentation
Client interviewing for taxable income and deductions
Explaining tax law to individuals and companies

evidence.quote: Prepare tax returns for individuals or small businesses. Use all appropriate adjustments, deductions, and credits to keep clients' taxes to a minimum.
Interview clients to obtain additional information on taxable income and deductible expenses and allowances. Answer questions and provide future tax planning to clients.
